bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)" = true || exit 60
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 61
v="$(docker exec deploy-postgres-1 psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U gace -d gaybbs -Atc "SELECT count(*) FROM startless_public_post_migrations WHERE state='uncertain';")" || exit 62
case "$v" in ''|*[!0-9]*) exit 63;; esac
test "$v" -le 80 || exit 64
echo "STARTLESS_UNCERTAIN_REMAINING=$v"
exit $((100+v))
